brief: Mixed-use tower, 24 storeys + 2 basement levels of parking (180 cars, ramps). Podium floors 1–3: retail (12 units, 2-storey atrium with escalators), floor 4: fitness and pool. Floors 5–12: Class A offices (open plan, 2 cores, raised floors). Floors 13–24: 160 apartments (studio/1/2/3-bed mix 20/40/30/10 %), balconies on south and west. Setback at floor 13 with roof terrace. Unitised curtain wall on the office part, ceramic panels with punched windows on the residential part. Concrete core + composite steel frame, 8.4 m grid. Full HVAC: AHUs on plant floor 12 and roof, VAV in offices, fan coils in apartments, smoke extract in atrium. Site 60×45 m with drop-off and landscaping.

Regional hospital, 220 beds. 4-storey diagnostic and treatment podium (emergency with ambulance bay, 8 operating theatres with clean corridor, ICU 24 beds, imaging: 2 MRI, 2 CT) and two 6-storey ward wings in an H-plan with courtyards. Wards: single and double rooms with ensuite, nurse stations per 32 beds. Separate circulation for patients, staff and logistics; 6 bed lifts, 2 service lifts, helipad on the roof. Interstitial plant floor above theatres. HVAC: 100 % fresh air for theatres with pressure cascade, HEPA, heat recovery; medical gases.

Secondary school for 1,200 pupils on a sloping site (6 m fall). Three wings around a courtyard (U-plan): teaching (36 classrooms, 8 science labs with fume cupboards), arts (music, drama studio, art), sport (double-height sports hall 34×18 m with spectator gallery, changing rooms). 500-seat auditorium with raked seating and stage. Library, dining for 400 with kitchen. Timber glulam roof over the sports hall, pitched roofs elsewhere, PV on south slopes. Accessible ramps and lifts, external terraces following the slope.

5-star hotel, 180 keys in a curved 10-storey slab facing the sea, with a 2-storey podium: lobby with 8 m high space, all-day restaurant, specialty restaurant, ballroom 600 m² divisible in 3, meeting rooms, spa with indoor pool. Rooms 38 m², suites on top two floors with large terraces, cantilevered sky bar on the roof. Back-of-house with service yard and loading. HVAC: 4-pipe fan coils in rooms, DOAS, kitchen extract, pool dehumidification.

Logistics warehouse 24,000 m², clear height 12 m, steel portal frames 30 m span at 12 m bays, 2 overhead cranes 10 t in the heavy bay, 40 loading docks with levellers and canopies, sprinkler and smoke vents. Attached 3-storey office block with mezzanine overlooking the hall, truck yard and parking for 150 cars.

300 m wrought-iron lattice observation tower: four curved lattice legs on masonry piers merging into a single shaft above the second platform, three viewing platforms (57 m, 115 m, 276 m), decorative arches between the legs at the first level, built-up riveted members, gusset plates at every node, lifts in the legs.

Residential quarter: three buildings on one podium — a 16-storey point tower, a 9-storey L-shaped block and a 6-storey courtyard block with townhouses on the ground floor. Shared underground car park (2 levels), landscaped podium garden with playground, ground-floor retail along the street. Brick facades with recessed loggias, pitched roofs on the low block, green roof on the podium.

Contemporary art museum with a free-form double-curved roof shell (steel gridshell, glass and metal panels) spanning 60 m over a column-free main gallery, a spiral ramp linking three gallery levels around a top-lit atrium, cantilevered auditorium of 300 seats, café terrace, and a sunken sculpture garden. Displacement ventilation with strict humidity control in galleries.

On the generated 12-storey office (open plan 1,500 m²/floor, 2 cores): design full HVAC for a typical floor — VAV supply 6 l/s/person + 1.5 l/s/m² extract, 1 person/10 m², ceiling void 600 mm. Size ducts by velocity (main ≤ 6 m/s, branches ≤ 4 m/s), diffusers on a 3×3 m grid at ceiling level, return via plenum grilles, fire dampers at every core wall crossing, AHU on roof with riser in each core. Report total airflow, duct sizes, pressure drop of the index run.

Hotel guest floor, 24 rooms: 4-pipe fan coils above each bathroom ceiling, fresh air from DOAS 30 m³/h/room via corridor duct, bathroom extract 15 l/s/room to roof fans, chilled/hot water pipes sized and insulated, condensate drains with fall, sleeves at all wall/slab penetrations.

Operating theatre suite (4 theatres + clean corridor + anaesthesia + scrub): 100 % fresh air, 25 ACH in theatres, laminar flow ceiling 3×3 m over the table, pressure cascade theatre +25 Pa > clean corridor +15 Pa > dirty corridor 0, HEPA terminal filters, run-around heat recovery, separate AHU per 2 theatres.

In the current office model, find all ducts and pipes clashing with beams or columns, reroute them (drop under beams or through allowed web openings ≤ 0.6 h), keep slopes for drains, and report every clash before/after.
How many doors are there per fire rating on each floor, what is the total curtain wall area per orientation, and which rooms are below 12 m²? Highlight them.

Check all stairs, corridors and doors against the egress rules (riser ≤ 175, tread ≥ 280, headroom ≥ 2.0 m, corridor ≥ 1.5 m, door clear width ≥ 0.9 m, travel distance ≤ 45 m). List violations and prepare fixes as a draft.

Convert floors 5–8 of the office into 40 apartments with balconies, keep the cores and structural grid, add bathrooms stacked over each other with risers, and update HVAC from VAV to fan coils + MVHR per apartment.

Design the moment connection between a HEB 400 column and an IPE 500 beam for M=320 kNm, V=180 kN: extended end plate, bolt grade 10.9, stiffeners if needed; show bolt layout, check edge distances and welds, and place it in the model.
